title: Sevaiiya Cheese Pull Pastry
description: A traditional Slovakian dessert made with sevaiiya, cheese, and pastry, perfect for a sweet snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: sevaiiya
ingredients.notes: find at an Asian grocery store or online

instructions: Combine the ricotta cheese, grated cheddar cheese, and granulated sugar in a bowl.
Unroll the sevaiiya and place it on a flat surface.
Roll out the sevaiiya to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spread the ricotta cheese mixture evenly over the sevaiiya, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the sevaiiya over the filling, creating a compact square.
Brush the top of the pastry with the beaten egg.
Cut the pastry into 6 equal pieces.
Place the pastry pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve warm, with a scoop of your favorite ice cream or whipped cream.
